blocks.content: If we combine all of the individual blocks of code together, we should get a fully-fledged program to implement a binary tree.

Node root was created
Node left was created
Node right was created
Node left was added as a left child of Node root
Node right was added as a right child of Node root
A tree was created
However, like with the implementation of general trees, this code is incomplete without methods of traversals.
We'll get to them next but before that, polish your skills with a practice exercise!
